title: Observational evidence for a possible link between PAH emission and dust trap locations in protoplanetary disks
question: Is the 3.3 micron PAH intensity of T Tauri and Herbig disks correlated with the warm (midplane T > 30 K) millimeter dust mass, as expected if PAHs are frozen out on pebbles and only sublimate once pebbles reach warm dust traps?

recipe.method: curve-of-growth radius enclosing 90% of the total flux; CASA imfit FWHM for marginally resolved compact disks
key_parameters: R_size measured at ~1 mm (Band 6 or 7) for most; longer wavelength for HD135344B, T Cha, HD179218

recipe.goal: derive total dust mass at 20 K
recipe.method: standard optically thin millimeter dust mass equation M = F d^2 / (kappa B(T)) at T = 20 K
key_parameters: kappa(1000 GHz) = 10 (units as printed: g cm^-2), kappa proportional to nu^beta with beta = 1
assumptions: dust temperature 20 K and optically thin emission

recipe.method: power-law passive-disk profile (Chiang and Goldreich) for non-transition disks; individually fitted RADMC-3D SED+continuum models for transition disks (or literature profiles)
key_parameters: RADMC-3D: outer radius 150 au, inner dust disk of 1 au depleted by delta_dust, scale height h(r)=h_c (r/r_c)^psi with psi = 0.15 and r_c = 50 au
assumptions: gas-to-dust ratio 100; small (0.005-1 um) and large (0.005-1000 um) grain populations

recipe.goal: compute warm dust mass inside the 30 K radius
recipe.method: integrate the millimeter flux from 0 to the radius where midplane T drops below 30 K, then convert to mass with the dust mass equation at T = 30 K
key_parameters: 30 K cutoff (CO snowline values of 18-35 K in the literature; 22-30 K range shown in profiles)
10% uncertainty from ALMA flux calibration; upper limit (total dust mass) used for WX Cha and Sz73
assumptions: 30 K is a reasonable single temperature because the dust mass is dominated by the temperature at the outer radius

recipe.method: integrate Kurucz stellar spectrum plus 10,000 K blackbody scaled to accretion luminosity over 912-2050 A; chi from L_FUV at 150 au scaled to ISRF; also at R_in and R_size

recipe.goal: test correlations between PAH 3.3 micron intensity and disk properties
recipe.method: linmix linear fit in log space including upper limits; Pearson correlation coefficients; repeated for detections only and for 6.2, 8.6, 11.3 micron features
key_parameters: 5 sigma PAH limits rescaled to 3 sigma limits for the FUV/total-dust-mass plots

recipe.goal: compare literature PAH spatial extents with CO and continuum profiles
recipe.method: overlay literature 3.3, 8.6, 11.3 micron PAH extents on 13CO radial profiles and ALMA continuum profiles for 7 targets
assumptions: 13CO 3-2 or 2-1 line profile is a proxy of the gas gap inside the dust cavity
